title: Analyzing Emergence Dynamics of Diabetes with Obesity
author: Yildirim, Sloot

steps.title: Create BMI‑based bifurcation model
steps.instruction: Generate a copy of the original ODE file, rename it, edit it to treat BMI as a parameter and replace body weight with the BMI‑height relation, then save the file for use with AUTO.

substeps.instruction: Copy the original model.ode file and name the copy model_bif.ode.
Open model_bif.ode with a text editor.
Add BMI as a new system parameter.
Define the relationship W = BMI·h^2 (where h is the subject’s height in meters and is also a parameter) to replace the explicit body‑weight variable.
Save model_bif.ode in the same directory as the other protocol files.

steps.title: Note usage restrictions
steps.instruction: Use model_bif.ode only for generating bifurcation diagrams with BMI as the continuation parameter; do not use it for ordinary model simulations because it lacks dynamic variables for body weight (W) and BMI.
